repo.name: oauth-mux
repo.description: Experimental, unshipped per-user account-continuity daemon with thin clients and Omux-owned native application adapters. Targets ordinary terminal launch/resume and compatible authorization handoff; live continuity remains unproved.

sbom.notes: No declared Bazel SBOM generation recipe or generated SBOM receipt is established. Runtime/tool inputs include pinned Zig, SQLite, libcurl and platform/UI dependencies through locked Nix/Bazel. Just and automatic CI execution lanes are retired; planned status and empty formats do not establish generated supply-chain evidence.
